dynamics.checked_independently: against a numerical integration of dx/dt = (target - x) / tau that shares no arithmetic with the writer

rejected.add_an_infusion_for_each_increment: several rates integrated together, and no exact form for a decrease before the steady effect
rejected.stop_the_old_infusion_and_start_a_new_on: two streams at once: with these constants a small increase overshoots the new steady support, and a small decrease first RAISES the support

dynamics.rule: the contribution approaches the steady support of the rate ordered (rate over half-effect rate), first order, with the writer's ONSET constant while it is below it and its OFFSET constant while it is above it
dynamics.what_direction_means: the contribution moves toward the rate ordered and never past it; against the same history WITHOUT the last order it is never above after a decrease or a stop and never below after an increase or a restart. It does NOT mean the contribution falls the moment a lower rate is ordered: a decrease ordered before the steady effect keeps rising toward the lower rate's steady support
dynamics.why_this_rule: it is the core's own closed form at both of its ends (a start from nothing rises with the onset constant, a stop decays with the offset constant) and it is continuous between them: a decrease to a rate near 0 behaves like a stop, a restart from a residue like a start. It is the simplest rule with those properties, not the only conceivable one: it is a development choice, and no faculty member has reviewed it yet

event_stream.increase_and_decrease_are_read_from_the_: the engine has one operation for both (adjust, with an absolute rate); which one an order was is read against the rate ordered before it
event_stream.model: ONE infusion: an ordered stream (t0, rate0), (t1, rate1), ..., (t_stop, 0); the rate ordered at a time is the LAST valid event at or before it; rates are never integrated together

operations.DECREASE: r -> r' below r and above 0
operations.IDEMPOTENT_NO_CHANGE: the same rate again, a bare continuation, or a stop of a stopped infusion: carried, nothing changes
operations.RESTART: 0 -> r after a stop, the same infusion
operations.START: 0 -> r (the run must have seen it)

event_stream.read_as_written: the order must itself say mcg/min; the one exception is a continuation that gives no rate and no units, which keeps the rate ordered before it (and the engine's receipt, when there, must say that rate). When a receipt is there it must agree with the order, or the order is refused

fail_closed.declared_and_never_raised: an action that is not a mapping, a rate too large to be a number, an order id that is not text: each is a declared gap, not an exception
refused: an operation that is not start, adjust, continue or stop
an order that gives no units (so a pressure target written as a bare number is never read as a rate)
units other than mcg/min (mcg/kg/min is never converted)
a rate that is not a finite positive number, or two different rates in one order
an order and a receipt that disagree
an adjustment, a continuation or a stop of an infusion the run never saw start
a rate the core's own writer refuses
an order that names no drug while the norepinephrine runs (the mirror does not say which infusion the engine changed)
an order without an identity or a whole minute, or orders against the clock (then none of the kind is mapped)
a second norepinephrine writer in the run (the run is refused)
fail_closed.rule: the first order the mapping cannot read closes the infusion: it and every later order of the kind are declared gaps, nothing after it is applied, and the run says it no longer mirrors the encounter's vasopressor
fail_closed.what_the_run_keeps_computing_after_a_ref: the history it had mapped, at its last rate, for the rest of the encounter: NOT what the engine runs. A shadow run has no safe value for an infusion it can no longer follow, so it says so and changes nothing else

governance.why: no file of clinical_core changes: the common state, its reader, the tone equation, the afterload and every constant are the certified ones; the rate history is a writer that IS the core's writer (a subclass in the development mapping module) and honours its writer contract

an_order_that_names_no_drug.why: an order that names no drug (an infusion adjustment) arrived while the encounter's norepinephrine was running: the engine applies it to whichever infusion is running and the mirror does not say to which, or to what rate, so it may have changed or stopped the norepinephrine and nothing is guessed

declared_gaps.a_receipt_that_disagrees: the engine's own receipt of this norepinephrine {operation} does not say what the order says ({what}): the two disagree, and nothing is guessed
declared_gaps.a_stop_of_nothing: a norepinephrine {operation} that leaves nothing running before any modelled interval carried the infusion: nothing was running, so there is nothing to build
declared_gaps.an_order_that_names_no_drug: an order that names no drug (an infusion adjustment) arrived while the encounter's norepinephrine was running: the engine applies it to whichever infusion is running and the mirror does not say to which, or to what rate, so it may have changed or stopped the norepinephrine and nothing is guessed
declared_gaps.another_action_type: an order mirrored as norepinephrine whose own action says it is {type}: the two disagree, and nothing is guessed
declared_gaps.another_operation: norepinephrine {operation} is not an operation this mapping reads (start, adjust, continue or stop, each with one absolute rate): nothing is guessed
declared_gaps.any_order_after_a_refused_one: norepinephrine {operation} after an order the run could not map is not mapped: the run keeps the infusion history it had mapped and no longer mirrors the encounter's vasopressor
declared_gaps.any_order_after_an_unmapped_first: the encounter's first norepinephrine order was not mapped, so the run does not mirror its vasopressor and maps no later order of the kind either
declared_gaps.never_seen_to_start: norepinephrine {operation} before any start the run saw: an infusion the run never saw start is not mapped
declared_gaps.no_identity_no_whole_minute_or_against_t: a norepinephrine order without an identity or a whole minute, or orders that arrive against the clock: the order of the encounter's infusion cannot be established, so none of its orders is mapped
declared_gaps.no_rate: a norepinephrine {operation} without a finite positive rate is not mapped
declared_gaps.no_units: a norepinephrine {operation} that gives no units is not mapped: the engine completes it from the running infusion, and this mapping reads only an order that says mcg/min itself (a bare number may be a pressure target, and is never read as a rate)
declared_gaps.other_units: norepinephrine in {units} is not mapped: only a fixed rate in mcg/min (a weight-based dose is never converted: it needs a weight this mapping does not read)
declared_gaps.replaced_within_its_minute: norepinephrine {operation} was replaced within its own minute by a later order, before any modelled interval: nothing carries it
declared_gaps.two_rates: a norepinephrine {operation} that carries two different rates is not mapped: nothing is guessed

not_granted: automatic titration (a pressure target, a protocol, a closed loop)

found.a_legacy_defect_found_and_not_touched: 'titrate norepinephrine to MAP 65' is parsed as an adjustment to a rate of 65 with no units, and the legacy engine runs it as 65 mcg/min when an infusion is running: outside this package, reported
found.action_type: norepinephrine (family_parser), with operation start / adjust / continue / stop; 'increase' and 'decrease' are read as adjust with ONE absolute target rate, and a relative change or two rates in one order is answered with a clarification, never executed
found.artifact_replay: a run is recomputed from arrival with the contributors mirrored so far, and a contributor that changes a minute already recorded is refused (HistoryRewritten); the artifact replays through the same function
found.corrected_after_the_adversarial_review: the first audit said a stop carries neither a rate nor units and did not find the orders that name no drug nor that the mirror hands the order over as written; the three are corrected above, and the verdict B stands
found.deferred_orders: an order held until a result is mirrored only when the engine runs it, at that minute; one the engine never ran is never mirrored
found.engine_state: ONE absolute active rate per infusion (family_state['norepinephrine']): every executed order replaces it, a stop sets it to 0; a weight-based rate is converted by the engine with the case's weight
found.identity_and_duplicates: one shadow order id per (minute, turn, position, kind) and the ledger's own order id; the same turn observed twice is mirrored once, and the mapping counts an order id once
found.orders_that_name_no_drug: 'stop the infusion' and 'increase the infusion rate to 20 mcg/min' are parsed as another action type, infusion_adjustment, which the engine resolves to the ONE running infusion among norepinephrine, nitroglycerin and dobutamine (and refuses when none or more than one runs)
found.persistence_and_serialization: the session keeps the mirrored actions; the replay artifact holds each action's identity (never the resident's text) and the scenario's contributors as plain data (integration.scenario_to_dict)
found.rate_and_units: rate with units mcg/min or mcg/kg/min (family_engine validates 0.001 to 100 mcg/min or 0.001 to 1.5 mcg/kg/min). A stop needs neither and may carry both ('stop norepinephrine 10 mcg/min'): it is a stop. An adjustment or a continuation may be WRITTEN without units or without a rate: the engine completes it from the running infusion (active_order_context) before it executes it
found.timestamp_and_minute: the mirror dates an order at the encounter minute of the state it was given from (sim_time before the turn); a held order is dated at the minute the engine executed it
found.what_the_mirror_hands_over: the PARSED action, as written, before the engine resolves or completes it, with the engine's receipt paired by the parsed kind: a norepinephrine order carries the engine's settled order in its receipt; an order that names no drug arrives as infusion_adjustment with an EMPTY receipt, so nothing in it says which infusion the engine changed
found.what_was_missing: the development mapping built only the encounter's FIRST start, and the core's writer represents one fixed rate with an optional stop: a rate that changes had no representation

replay.a_rate_history_replays_where: in a process that has loaded the development mapping module (the type is registered there); elsewhere the artifact is refused by name, never approximated
replay.historical_single_start_artifacts: replay unchanged: the single start still builds the core's own writer, with the same specification
replay.registration: the type registers when the module is imported and the mapping registers BOTH writers it builds -- the core's own and the rate history -- each time it builds (ensure_registered): a registry that was swapped when a module was first imported does not keep the registration, and the full certification found that this happens to the core's own writer under a module-scoped historical view (not caused by this package: the same order fails on the base commit). A historical view of an earlier tree filters the registry by the core's own new types only, so the rate-history type, which is the Phase-3 layer's and not the core's, stays listed inside such a view: nothing there builds it
the_artifact_binds: every order's identity, minute and receipt digest (actions)
the rate history ((minute, rate), ...) and its units
every order the infusion carries, with its outcome
the witness values and the lineage member (the snapshot's provenance) and the declared profile field
replay.what_it_cannot_check: that the orders it names are the encounter's: that is the artifact's, which stores the mirrored actions beside the contributors. The core's replay does not check the witness constants in a specification against the declared witness either (it never did, for any contributor)
replay.what_the_writer_checks_of_its_own_accoun: one order a minute, in time; the first is the start, at the first rate; each outcome is what its rate did to the rate before it; and the rate history is exactly what the orders make

temporal_contract.a_reason_never_stops_being_true: the session's gaps only accumulate, so a declared order never becomes a carried one when more orders arrive: each reason depends on the order, on those before it, and on whether a later order of its own minute exists
temporal_contract.deferred_execution: a held order acts from the minute the engine executed it, never from the minute it was placed
temporal_contract.first_physiologic_effect: the support first moves over (s, s + 1]; the tone, which follows the state one minute behind, and the pressure first move over (s + 1, s + 2]
temporal_contract.no_look_ahead: a minute's contribution depends on the orders before it only
temporal_contract.no_retroactive_change: nothing at or before the order minute changes; a contributor that would change a recorded minute is refused by the runner
temporal_contract.order_minute: the encounter minute of the state the order was given from
temporal_contract.same_minute: within one minute the LAST valid order in the engine's order is the one a modelled interval carries, and the ONLY one the infusion carries; an earlier one is a declared gap (replaced within its minute). When the last order of the minute is one the mapping refuses, the valid ones before it in that minute are replaced too, and the history the run keeps ends before that minute
temporal_contract.the_engines_order_is_the_mirrors: orders are read in the order the mirror holds them; an order dated before one that came before it is refused with every order of the kind
temporal_contract.turn_boundaries_and_reassessment: the trajectory does not depend on how the minutes are divided into turns

writer.reads: its own orders and time (the writer contract): no pressure, tone, output, delivery or any other reading
writer.writes: one VasoconstrictionChange a minute to the common vasoconstrictor support; no channel, no pressure, no volume, no pump

predictions_written_before_the_runs.DIRECTION: after an INCREASE or a RESTART the support, the tone and the pressure are never below the run without that order, and above it somewhere; after a DECREASE or a STOP they are never above it, and below it somewhere
predictions_written_before_the_runs.HISTORICAL: the plain start at 10 mcg/min builds the core's own writer (type norepinephrine), exactly as before this package; the run in which the order is not mapped is the same, state by state, whatever the orders were
predictions_written_before_the_runs.ORDERING: in probe E the support at the end of each plateau orders as the rates do: 10 mcg/min above 5 above 4 above the stopped infusion, which is at or above 0; the pressure relative to the run without any mapped order orders the same way
predictions_written_before_the_runs.PERSISTENCE_AND_DECAY: with an unchanged rate the support approaches that rate's steady support and never passes it (and, added after the review, it is within 1e-7 of an independent numerical integration of the first-order equation); after a STOP it is NOT erased in the minute of the stop, it decays by the offset constant alone (the core's own closed form, bit for bit), it is never negative, less than 1 % of what it was at the stop is left 12 minutes later, and at least 90 % of the pressure effect the infusion had at the stop is gone 22 minutes after it (probe D)
predictions_written_before_the_runs.SMOOTHNESS: the support never moves in the minute of an order, and in no minute by more than its own first-order step (the distance to the ordered rate's steady support times 1 - exp(-1/tau), tau the onset constant while it rises and the offset constant while it falls); the largest one-minute change of the tone against the run without any mapped order is, in every probe, at most the largest one in the plain start at 10 mcg/min
predictions_written_before_the_runs.TIMING: an order at minute s changes nothing at or before s: the support is the same as in the run without that order through minute s and first differs at s + 1; the tone and the pressure are the same through s + 1 and first differ at s + 2 (the tone moves one minute behind the state that calls for it)
predictions_written_before_the_runs.UNTOUCHED_STATE: the volume, the pump, the hemoglobin and the lung water are the same, minute by minute, as in the run without any mapped order: the orders change the tone and nothing else

the mirror hands an order over as it was written, before the engine resolves or completes it.
